svg.title: Kaung L Joy — Senior Mobile Developer
svg.desc: A World of Warcraft–style title screen: twin moons over dark mountains and a glowing arcane rune circle. The name Kaung L Joy in carved gold letters, a title plate reading Senior Mobile Developer, the guild tag Optionenter and the realm Yangon, Myanmar. An experience bar lists Flutter, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI and Go.
